headline: Last session: Sensex crashed 876 points to 73,852 as Nifty fell below 22,900 amid widespread selling.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: Heavy selling in private banking and IT stocks dragged down the main benchmark indices.
Major heavyweights like Infosys and Tata Motors PV suffered steep losses of around 3% each.
Widespread market weakness resulted in investors losing around Rs 4-5 lakh crore in market capitalization.
Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE are closed today, October 20, 2026, due to Dussehra.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Sensex plunged 876.37 points to settle at 73,852.90 while Nifty dropped to 22,888.95.
PSU banking and metal stocks bucked the broader market crash to show resilience during the previous session.
BSE and NSE are closed for trading today for Dussehra and will reopen on Wednesday, October 21.
Paras Healthcare raised Rs 652.50 crore from anchor investors ahead of its IPO opening on October 21.
summary: In the last session, Indian markets experienced a major drop as Sensex fell 876 points and Nifty ended below 22,900. Private banks and IT majors led the slide, while metals and PSU banks provided partial support. Indian markets are closed today for Dussehra and will reopen on Wednesday.
